sourceTitle: Jacket Potatoes With Apple and Onion
sourceText:
Jacket Potatoes With Apple and Onion
By: Foo Nineteen23425
Published: Friday, December 10, 2010 - 1:02am

Ingredients




4 larges Potatoes
25 grams Butter or vegetable margarine, (1oz)
1 small Cooking apple, peeled, cored and chopped finely
1 small Onion, chopped finely

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 200 C/400 F/Gas Mark 6. 2 Scrub the potatoes and prick them on both sides with a fork. Lay them on the oven rack and bake them for 1 1/4 hours or until they are soft. 3 Cut the potatoes in half lengthways. Scoop out the middles and mash them with the butter or margarine. Mix the apple and onion into the potato. 4 Put the potato shells in a heatproof dish. Pile the stuffing mixture inside them and make ridges on the tops with a fork. Return the potatoes to the oven for 15 minutes or until the tops are beginning to brown.
